title: The Chalkbone Maul
summary: Something to carry out of the Rings, crush where the cleaver is slash and the spear is stab.
author: claude
notes: content: Marrow's Forge will now band a chalk hod's frame in chalkbone bar to build a maul, crush where the cleaver is slash and the spear is stab.
content: Marrow's Forge has started stocking chalk hods, for anyone who would rather buy than dig one out from under a hauler.

items.name: Chalkbone maul
items.examine: A chalk hod's frame, banded in chalkbone and swung the other way.
